Title: Toward Interpretable Topic Discovery via Anchored Correlation Explanation
In this workshop paper, we introduce a simple approach to anchored information theoretic topic modeling using a novel combination of Correlation Explanation (CorEx) (Ver Steeg & Galstyan, 2014) and the information bottle- neck (Tishby et al., 2000). This ﬂexible framework enables the user to leverage domain knowledge to guide exploration of a collection of documents and to impose semantics onto latent factors learned by CorEx.

Title: Toward Interpretable Topic Discovery via Anchored Correlation Explanation
We propose a simple way to use fuzzy and informal knowledge from experts to guide discovery of interpretable latent topics in text. The underlying intuition of our approach is that latent factors should be informative about both correlations in the data and a set of relevance variables speciﬁed by an expert. Mathematically, this approach is a combination of the information bottleneck and Total Correlation Explanation (CorEx).

answer: 专家知识通过“锚点词”(anchor words/锚点变量)的方式融入主题模型：专家指定一组相关性变量(relevance variables),模型在 CorEx 目标函数中加入第二项——即锚点变量 X_i 与隐因子 Y_j 之间的互信息项(对集合 R 中指定的 (i, j) 对)，权重为 β;该项受 information bottleneck 启发，使隐因子在解释数据中多元相关性的同时，也对专家指定的锚点变量保持信息量 [7][13][17]。这样，用户可以利用领域知识引导文档集合的探索，并为 CorEx 学到的隐因子赋予语义 [1],实验表明引入简单的锚点词能提升主题的连贯性和可解释性 [11]。
